plugins.name: pr-code-review
plugins.description: Multi-model AI code review. An orchestrator skill dispatches read-only code-reviewer sub-agents that report coverage-first findings with confidence scores; the orchestrator filters and synthesizes them into a findings report plus machine-readable JSON.

plugins.name: claude-auto-repo-setup
plugins.description: SessionStart + CwdChanged hooks that auto-wire local-only Claude conveniences in the current git repo: CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md, and .claude/skills & .claude/agents symlinks to .github/. Idempotent and never commits anything.

plugins.name: azure-kusto
plugins.description: Azure Data Explorer and KQL guidance for querying logs, telemetry, time series, and ADX resources.

plugins.name: azure-pipelines
plugins.description: Azure Pipelines YAML guidance with schema-aware language server support for pipelines and templates.

plugins.name: run-simplify
plugins.description: Code-quality cleanup pass over a diff. Four parallel review agents look for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude issues, then the fixes are applied. Adapted from the Claude Code built-in `simplify` skill.

plugins.name: human-message-style
plugins.description: Rules for drafting concise, natural chat messages, emails, announcements, PR comments, and short teammate-facing summaries.

plugins.name: sembr
plugins.description: Reflow prose into Semantic Line Breaks (sembr.org), one thought per line, across Markdown, AsciiDoc, reStructuredText, LaTeX, and other markup while preserving rendered output.
